evidence.reason: The acquire path fsyncs the token file but never fsyncs the marker's parent directory after the O_EXCL creation. On a power loss the directory entry can be lost even though the token file was fsynced, so the admission hold may not survive reboot. This is a concrete crash-consistency gap, not merely a hardening proposal, because the code already treats marker persistence as crash-critical and raises RecoveryRequired when the token cannot be persisted. Add a parent-directory fsync after creation, and analogously after removal, and surface sync failure as an unverified admission transition.
